title: Warm Fjord Norwegian Tofu Grill
description: A sweet, velvety Norwegian dish featuring marinated tofu, served in a traditional Dolsot stone bowl.

ingredients.name: Fjord-inspired vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, parsnips, and Brussels sprouts

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together maple syrup, lemon juice, coconut aminos, ginger powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add pressed tofu to the marinade and coat evenly.
Let the tofu marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the marinated tofu for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Meanwhile, toss the fjord-inspired vegetables with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Grill the vegetables for 5-7 minutes, or until tender and lightly charred.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of the grilled vegetables in the Dolsot stone bowl.
Slice the grilled tofu into thick slices and arrange on top of the vegetables.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
